'''Charros IV''', also referred to simply as '''Charros''', was an arid [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] with high plateaus, snow-capped [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], and black-[[Water/Legends|water]] [[lake]]s.

==History==
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Shady Deal" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Ingor Watt]] planned to sell stolen [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] on Charros IV.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Shady Deal}}</ref>

The Charros IV [[Xi Char/Legends|Xi Char]] cathedral factories were infiltrated by [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] in [[45 BBY/Legends|45 BBY]]; the [[Xi Charrian/Legends|Xi Charrians]] were infuriated when he was exposed as an infidel. The [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] government manufactured [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid, Mark Is]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]; to the Xi Charrians, these were works of art. [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]] was headquartered on the planet, but abandoned the world after being attacked during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the planet was under the control of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Treuten Teradoc]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] freed the planet during the [[Post–Zsinj campaigns]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]]. The planet joined the New Republic shortly after. It was a New Republic stronghold during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TEA" />

The world was also conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] sometime around [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
